$comment: Re-derived (2.0.0) from the real page files: each template = one distinct page shape, sections listed in render order with choice-slot alternatives right after their primary; chrome (nav, footer CTA block, footer) comes from src/components/Layout.jsx. src/pages/__preview-* are build-time preview routes and are excluded. The design-repo (design-repo/templates/templates.json) carries the machine-checked slot grammar (required/repeatable/variants/alternatives).

meta.source: Local clone of https://www.thrivelearning.com/ -- '/' (src/pages/Home.jsx) + the 57 routes in src/routes.js
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill (re-derived from page files, wave 3)

categories.SHELL: Site chrome on every route: fixed navigation and footer card (rendered once by Layout.jsx).
categories.HERO: Page-opening block carrying the page H1 (or a mid-page reuse of a hero component, see SECONDARY_HERO_USES).
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, outcome stats, testimonials, case studies.
categories.PRODUCT: Product explanation modules: tabs, sliders, bentos, feature rows, comparison tables.
categories.STORY: Editorial blocks: statements, scroll quote, videos, marquees, split image/text stories, news.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to capture a demo/contact request, answer pre-sale objections or show pricing.
categories.INDEX: Filterable or listing collections (blog, events, guides, glossary, integrations, case studies), including such a block when it also carries the page H1.

article.cs-content-article.description: Hairline-bordered two-column block on the legacy content ("yellow") theme. Left 30%: sticky sidebar with an "In this article" TOC (on the real pages every H2, section titles and sub-headings, is listed via tocFromHeadings), a Share row with three icon buttons and a dotted-texture CTA card with a yellow pill button. Right 70%: rich-text sections (title H2, then a sequence of paragraphs with **bold**/[[link]] spans, sub-heading H2s, spacer/empty paragraphs, centred or full-width figures and yellow-ruled blockquotes), followed by a dotted-texture quote card (quote, avatar, name, role). At 767 and below the sidebar moves under the article and the TOC is hidden.
article.cs-content-article.scope: Listed on 5 routes: Case study detail (content).

article.cs-platform-header.description: Article header of the case-study-platform template (the page opens here; it carries the H1, so the template has no separate hero): customer logo top-left, serif 3.8rem H1 bottom-left over a radial-masked hero image (min-height 60vh), a static play-video ring icon on the right, then a 4-column row of info cards (1 column at tablet and below): two stat cards, a challenge-tag card and an integrations-chip card, the last stat card carrying a 'See how' anchor link.
article.cs-platform-header.scope: Listed on 5 routes: Case study detail (platform).

article.cs-platform-body.description: Article body of the case-study-platform template: a two-column layout with a sticky left TOC (section titles + Testimonial entry, scroll-spy highlight, sidebar demo card; the sidebar is hidden at 479 and below) beside the article (H2 + rich paragraphs per chapter, optional inline image), a testimonial card, and a serif video heading with a video placeholder and caption. The page's header (logo, H1, info cards) and closing CTA are separate sections (article.cs-platform-header, conversion.cs-platform-cta).
article.cs-platform-body.scope: Listed on 5 routes: Case study detail (platform).

conversion.cs-platform-cta.description: Closing call to action of the case-study-platform template: a centred serif H2 (text-h2, mob h2-mob, xs h2-xs) whose characters scrub from near-black to white on scroll, then one primary button that rises in (buttons stack at 479 and below).
conversion.cs-platform-cta.scope: Listed on 5 routes: Case study detail (platform).

conversion.contact-form.description: Legacy green-theme bordered block in container-large (/contact-us): a 40% / 60% grid (one column <=767, gap 2rem). Left: 1.75rem H3, two grey paragraphs separated by a blank line, and a row of three review badges. Right: a static HubSpot-footprint form (fixed 300x1020px, white Helvetica labels): intro line, four text inputs, an employee-count select, a file input, a requirements textarea, an empty captcha-sized box and a Submit button. Submit is prevented; nothing is sent.

conversion.content-pricing.description: Two-column grid (1.25fr / 1fr, gap 6rem; one column <=767). Left: yellow-chip eyebrow, H1 at h2 scale, grey intro and three independently toggling accordion cards (question + optional bold lead + answer). Right: a surface-2 content plan card with eyebrow, lead line, a static learners select, a question, two custom checkbox tiles (core library / sector packs), a computed placeholder price with a currency select, a primary CTA, and a yellow-tick feature list; under the card an outlined box runs a vertical testimonial ticker (logo, italic quote, avatar, name, role). Nothing submits: the checkboxes and selects only recompute the on-page placeholder price.

conversion.cta-strip.description: One component with a `variant` prop. 'heading' (all 17 /lms/features/* routes, after the product tabs): centred one-line H2 (60rem max, balanced) over a primary button, margin 4rem top / 3rem bottom. 'pricing' (/lms/small-business): the same header inside padding-global/container-medium with a 0.5rem top margin and a 2rem spacer below. 'spacer' (/lms/mentoring-software): an empty 5rem (3rem <=767) padded block reproducing the original's empty section. 'button' (/lms/features with pullUp's -4rem top margin, /lms/enterprise; visually also the inline row on /nova): a lone centred primary button; buttons stack column-wise <=767.
conversion.cta-strip.scope: Listed on 22 routes: Feature detail; Segment landing: small business; Segment landing: enterprise; Features index (sticky anchor tabs); AI agent product page; Mentoring software product page.

conversion.demo-cta.description: The SUBPAGE_CTA block that Footer renders above the footer card when its real `variant` prop is 'subpage' (Layout.jsx passes 'subpage' on every route except '/' and '/company', which get the 'home' variant = conversion.demo-form). A centred 40rem column, gap 2rem: Nimbus wordmark, H2 whose last three words are italic, an 18px ink paragraph (max 32rem) and one green accent pill button linking to /lms/demo-platform; no form. Padding 3rem (1.5rem at <=479); the column simply narrows on smaller screens. It sits inside the <footer> element, directly above the shared footer card.
conversion.demo-cta.scope: Listed on 56 routes: Feature detail; Case study detail (platform); Case study detail (content); Content catalogue (topics / sector suites); Platform overview; Segment landing: small business; Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise; Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Professional services (legacy grid system); Impact (legacy layout, pink theme); Integrations directory; Release notes landing; Book a demo; Pricing; Features index (sticky anchor tabs); AI agent product page; Mentoring software product page; Content overview; Content service (legacy layout); Custom content; Mentoring programmes; Case study index (platform, filterable); Case study index (content); Why us; What's included; Contact; Events & webinars index; Blog & news index; Guides index; Glossary index.

conversion.demo-form.description: Demo-request block at the top of the footer: heading and copy beside a 300px form (static placeholder standing in for the original HubSpot embed).
conversion.demo-form.scope: Opens the footer on the 2 routes with the form footer ('/' and '/company').

conversion.faq.description: FAQ H2 with five independently toggling accordion items (open 450ms / close 650ms outQuart, plus-icon rotation). Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (subpage).
conversion.faq.scope: Listed on 36 routes: Marketing homepage; Feature detail; Platform overview; Segment landing: small business; Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise; Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Release notes landing; Book a demo; Pricing; Features index (sticky anchor tabs); AI agent product page; Mentoring software product page; Custom content; Mentoring programmes; Case study index (platform, filterable); Company; Why us; What's included; Contact.

conversion.faq-empty.description: Page-local CMS empty state of the feature-page FAQ (data-section 'faq', data-variant 'empty'): padding 5rem / 4rem tab / 3rem mob, a centred serif H2 (60rem max) and, 4.375rem below, a single 42rem-wide surface-1 bar with the message 'No FAQs found.' in body text. No accordion, no interaction. Rendered by FeatureDetail in place of the FAQ when the route's data has `empty: true`.

conversion.faq-legacy.description: Relume-style 'grid lines' FAQ in container-large: a centred header cell (42rem wide, bordered left/right) with a pill eyebrow and a 3rem (2rem <=767) H2, then a single-column 42rem accordion of bordered rows (bold 1.25rem question cell + a separate square plus-icon cell), then a bottom spacer cell with a centre line (12rem; omitted for the green theme). The `theme` prop picks the line/open colours: 'olive' (/content/topics, /content/sector-suites), 'olive-items' (/content: item lines also olive) and 'green' (/lms/integrations: no top border, no bottom spacer). Outer side borders drop at <=991; one item can be open on load.
conversion.faq-legacy.scope: Listed on 4 routes: Content catalogue (topics / sector suites); Integrations directory; Content overview.

conversion.glossary-cta.description: Oldest-system block (fixed 16px root) on /resources/lms-glossary: an 80rem container holding a #1b1b1b rounded (10px) card. Centred stack of the Nimbus wordmark, a 2.5rem (1.875rem <=767) H2, one line of white 1.25rem copy and two small green pill-less buttons side by side (stacked <=767), then a wide 1300:582 product image filling the card bottom. The card rises and fades in once when it enters the viewport.

conversion.pricing-plans-legacy.description: Legacy purple-hairline (#570039) block: centred serif 4rem H2 header over a shrink-to-fit 2-plan grid (second plan tinted #3b041d); each plan = name, serif 3rem price, period, then a count label (+ optional note) with a large count at the bottom-right. Below, a centred 36rem feature list: grey lead line + rows with top/left hairlines. Plans stack to one column <=479. No variants or theme prop.
conversion.pricing-plans-legacy.scope: Listed on 1 route: Impact (legacy layout, pink theme).

conversion.why-cta.description: A bare centred block (72rem max, margin 4rem top / 6rem bottom) holding a serif H2 and, 1rem below, a single primary button. No background or card. Side padding 1.5rem <=767 and 1rem <=479, where the button stretches to full width.

hero.assistant-video.description: Full-width stage (/nova) 85vh tall (max 60rem) holding a centred 1440:500 background-video band; under it a centred block (max 42rem): serif 4rem/1.1 H1 with one italic word, grey intro with a bold phrase, and primary + dark buttons (the dark one carries an AI icon). <=767 the block is pulled up -12rem over the stage; <=479 the video band becomes 3:2, 15rem tall.
hero.assistant-video.scope: Listed on 1 route: AI agent product page.

hero.center-legacy.description: Centred hero inside hairline frame lines in the legacy theme colours. One component with `variant`: 'services' (/lms/professional-services; full hairline box, eyebrow tag, H1 3.8rem/1.1 max 60rem, ink paragraph, theme pill button stacked over 3 overlapping avatars + proof line) and 'custom' (/content/custom-content; top + side hairlines, extra 4rem top padding, 115x38 brand logo slot, H1 3.8rem/1.15 max 41.2rem, paragraph, button). Padding steps down at 991/767/479.
hero.center-legacy.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Professional services (legacy grid system); Custom content.

hero.company-video.description: Full-viewport header (/company; min-h 100svh, max 60rem) with a background-video slot under a 50% black wash and a bottom-up #00030a gradient; white centred content sits at the bottom: serif 4rem/1.1 H1 (2.5rem <=767), 20px lead, primary button and a dark 'ask AI' button with an icon track. Buttons wrap and stretch <=479.

hero.content-overview.description: Legacy content ('yellow') theme, three parts (/content): (1) a hairline-framed centred hero: sub-brand lockup, serif 3.8rem H1, paragraph, yellow pill button + 3 overlapping avatars and a social line; (2) a one-line caption and 6-logo row; (3) a 2-column feature: serif 3.5rem H2, grey paragraphs with two inline links, quote card with avatar, name and role | square image card with a yellow button. The feature stacks <=767.

hero.demo-form.description: In container-large (/lms/demo-platform): avatar strip + trust line, then three 2-column grids (gap 5rem): [serif 3.8rem/1.1 H1 | serif 1.75rem form title, bottom-aligned], [grey intro with one bold phrase, 4-item bullet list and 3 review badges | static 300x358 form placeholder], [quote | quote]. At <=479 grids become one column, the form moves above the copy and the second quote is hidden.
hero.demo-form.scope: Listed on 1 route: Book a demo.

hero.global-header-legacy.description: Top + side hairline frame (no bottom border) with legacy header padding. One component with `variant`: 'eyebrow' (/contact-us; centred eyebrow tag, H1 3.8rem/1.1, grey paragraph) and 'logo' (/case-studies/content; centred content-brand logo, H1 3.8rem/1.15, grey paragraph that keeps the original's 12rem left offset). No buttons. The file also exports the shared legacy theme primitives (legacyVars, LegacyButton, LegacyEyebrow).
hero.global-header-legacy.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Case study index (content); Contact.

hero.header-grid-card.description: Legacy content ('yellow') theme, two hairline-framed grid cells (one column <=767): left card with a dark eyebrow pill, serif 3rem/1.1 H1 (2rem <=479), grey paragraph and a yellow pill button; right cell is media. One component with `variant`: 'topics' (/content/topics) shows a 923:600 header image (3:2 <=991); 'suites' (/content/sector-suites) shows a 500px background-video slot. Content shape is identical.
hero.header-grid-card.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Content catalogue (topics / sector suites).

hero.integrations-header.description: Green legacy styling (/lms/integrations): a hairline-bordered 2-column card (copy: eyebrow tag, serif 3.8rem/1.1 H1, 18px paragraph, green pill button + 3 overlapping avatars and a users line | full-height visual, 3:2 <=991), one column <=767. Below: a centred logo lead line + 6 logos, then a split header (heading-h2 left, grey paragraph right; stacked <=991).

hero.layout2-media.description: A rounded media card (min-h 42rem, p 2.5rem; 30rem / 1.5rem <=767) with media behind a transparent-to-black gradient and bottom-aligned content, framed by legacy hairlines. One component with `variant`: 'impact' (/lms/impact; logo + H1 + para, CTA right, top border), 'service' (/content/service; logo + H1 + para + CTA below), 'case-study' (/case-studies-contents/customer-6..10; customer logo + H1 max 47rem + decorative play button), 'company' (/company, mid-page before the FAQ; no hairlines, eyebrow chip + H2 + para + primary Button) and 'events' (/resources/events-webinars; H1 + CTA over a background-video slot).
hero.layout2-media.scope: Listed on 9 routes: Case study detail (content); Impact (legacy layout, pink theme); Content service (legacy layout); Company; Events & webinars index.

hero.logos-overlap.description: The `.section_wowlogos.is-neg-overlap` block on /lms/corporate-lms: pulled up -16rem (-10 / -8 / -6rem at 991 / 767 / 479) over the empty WowContentHero 'corporate' spacer. Split row: avatar strip + trust line, serif 3.8rem H1 (2.5rem <=479), grey paragraph, quote card (italic quote, avatar, name, role + linked company) and primary CTA | 1440:920 product visual; stacks <=767. Below: centred lead line + 7 logos.
hero.logos-overlap.scope: Listed on 1 route: Segment landing: mid-market.

hero.mentoring-software.description: A wide hero image (150% of the container, 35rem tall, black-to-transparent top fade) pulled up -8rem under the nav, then a centred block overlapping it by 3rem: avatar strip + trust line, two-line serif H1 (h1 token), 20px grey copy (lead line + paragraph), brand-blue primary and dark buttons; then a logo lead line and 6 logos. <=767 the image becomes an in-flow 3:2 card with radius and buttons stack <=479.
hero.mentoring-software.scope: Listed on 1 route: Mentoring software product page.

hero.platform.description: Split hero (/lms, pulled up -1rem): left column has a serif 3.8rem H1 (2.5rem <=479), grey intro, italic quote with 40px avatar, name and role + linked company, and a primary CTA; right column is a 1440:1339 product visual. Below, a centred one-line lead and an 8-slot logo row (flex space-between, max 60rem, wrapping and centring <=991). Columns stack <=767.

hero.pricing-calculator.description: Centred column (/pricing): eyebrow chip, heading-h2-sized H1, grey intro and 3 review badges; a 'We have [learners] learners' custom dropdown; a plan card (currency dropdown top-right, plan eyebrow, lead, large serif price computed from the selected bracket, primary CTA + dark button that opens a right-hand feature drawer, check list); under the card a results ticker that steps through one stat row at a time. The drawer (hidden <=479) has a title, intro, tab buttons and cross-fading screenshot panes. Card contents stack <=479.

hero.split-visual.description: Two-column hero: avatar row + trust line, serif H1, subtitle, three review badges, primary + dark buttons on the left; a 1440:1089 product collage bleeding past the right viewport edge. Load-time staggered blur/skew reveal. Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (feature-detail).
hero.split-visual.scope: Listed on 18 routes: Marketing homepage; Feature detail.

hero.wow-content.description: One component with a `variant` prop that switches between ten measured layouts of the `.section_wowcontent` hero: split layouts (copy left, media right, stacking to one column <=767) for small-business, enterprise, features, mentoring, case-studies and why; centred single-column layouts for solutions, spring-release and whats-included; and an empty spacer for corporate. Routes: small-business /lms/small-business, corporate /lms/corporate-lms, enterprise /lms/enterprise, solutions /lms/solutions, spring-release /lms/spring-release, features /lms/features, mentoring /mentoring, case-studies /case-studies/lms, why /company/why-nimbus, whats-included /whats-included. The H1 is serif 3.8rem/1.15 (2.5rem <=767) except case-studies (heading-h2 size).
hero.wow-content.scope: Listed on 10 routes: Segment landing: small business; Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise; Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Release notes landing; Features index (sticky anchor tabs); Mentoring programmes; Case study index (platform, filterable); Why us; What's included.

index.blog-featured.description: Legacy 'green' styling inside side hairlines (/resources/blog-and-news): (1) page header row with eyebrow tag, serif 3.8rem H1 and 20px lead; (2) a featured-post link card, 0.8fr image | 1fr content (H2-sized title, grey excerpt, 'Written by' avatar + author, date and read-time tags), one column <=767 and meta row reversed <=479; (3) a #001811 subscribe callout with a heading, sub line and a static email field + button (no submission). The SubscribeCallout part is also exported and reused by EventsUpcoming.
index.blog-featured.scope: Listed on 1 route: Blog & news index.

index.blog-filter.description: Hairline-bordered block on the legacy "green" theme. Left 20%: sticky "Filter by category" checkbox list (2-column grid at 991 and below, wrapping row at 479). Right 80%: a header row "Showing N articles out of M" with a Sort by dropdown (newest / oldest), a 2-column grid (1 at 479) of post cards (image, serif title, date and read-time pills) and a "Load more" pill that reveals 20 more. Client-side filtering, OR across ticked categories.
index.blog-filter.scope: Listed on 1 route: Blog & news index.

index.cs-content-list.description: Unfiltered CMS-style grid on the content ("yellow") legacy theme: 3 columns (2 at 767 and below, 1 at 479 and below) of hairline-bordered link cards, each with a customer logo top-left, a short summary and a "Learn more ›" label at the bottom. Sits under the page's legacy header; carries no heading of its own.
index.cs-content-list.scope: Listed on 1 route: Case study index (content).

index.cs-content-related.description: Hairline-bordered block on the content ("yellow") theme: a left-aligned serif 4rem H2 header row, then a 3-column grid (1 column at 767 and below) of fixed-aspect cards, each with a customer logo, a one-sentence summary and a "Learn more ›" link to that case study. Not a slider.
index.cs-content-related.scope: Listed on 5 routes: Case study detail (content).

index.cs-filter-grid.description: Dark-theme block: left-aligned H2, then a filter bar ("All" reset + three click-open checkbox dropdowns with two-column option lists; OR within a dropdown, AND across them; the button shows the ticked values) above a 3-column grid (2 at 991 and below, 1 at 767 and below) of rounded case-study cards with a customer logo and a two-line headline. Shows an empty-state line when no card matches. On /case-studies/lms the bar stays in flow (stickyBar false).
index.cs-filter-grid.scope: Listed on 1 route: Case study index (platform, filterable).

index.events-past.description: Hairline-bordered block on the legacy "green" theme: centred serif 4rem H2, then a 2-column grid (1 at 479) of fixed-aspect cells (auto height at 991 and below), each with an optional green month-year label, a big day number, a title and a "Watch now ›" link. On hover a photo layer with a 75% black overlay fades in behind the cell. An optional year-pill filter exists (showFilter) but no page enables it.
index.events-past.scope: Listed on 1 route: Events & webinars index.

index.events-upcoming.description: Hairline-bordered block on the legacy "green" theme: centred serif 4rem H2, a 3-column list (1 at 767) of upcoming-event link cards (date chip with green gradient and left rule, semibold event name, "Register today ›"), then the shared newsletter callout (heading, sub line, static email field + Subscribe button). The live CMS had a single event.
index.events-upcoming.scope: Listed on 1 route: Events & webinars index.

index.glossary.description: Oldest-system block (fixed 16px root) carrying the page H1: centred serif H1, a multi-line intro and a static email sign-up row; an A-Z pill radio filter ("All" + 26 letters, filters terms by first letter) with a "Showing N results." line; then a 3-column grid (2 at 991, 1 at 767) of rounded #1b1b1b term cards ("What is X?" heading, definition, "Read more" chip). Hovering a card dims the others to 50%.

index.guides.description: Oldest-system block (fixed 16px root) carrying the page H1: centred serif H1, one line of intro and a static email sign-up row; then a featured guide card (#1b1b1b, 550px tall, title + text + Download button on the left half, guide cover on the right, under a 65% black blurred layer); then a 3-column grid (2 at 767, 1 at 479) of guides, each a cover image, 1.875rem title, short text and a Download button.

index.integration-filter.description: Hairline-bordered (#00251e) block: left 20% sticky "Filter by category" checkbox list (wrapping row at 991, 2-column grid at 479); right 80% header "Showing N connections out of M" with a Sort by dropdown (Name A-Z / Z-A) above a 3-column grid (2 at 991, 1 at 479) of integration cards (logo mark, arrow chip, serif name). OR filter across ticked categories. Same filter layout family as the blog filter but with name sort and logo cards.

index.topics-grid.description: Legacy content (yellow) theme: a centred serif 4rem H2 header in a side-hairline frame over a 3-col grid (1 col <=767) of hairline link cards, each with a 20px/500 title, grey copy and a 3:2 topic image; hover reveals a dotted radial-gradient texture instantly. The component also has a 'suites' variant (split header + button + 6 sector cards) but no real page uses it; only 'topics' (/content/topics) is live and modelled.
index.topics-grid.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Content catalogue (topics / sector suites).

index.webinars-upcoming.description: Two-column hairline block on the legacy "green" theme (stacked at 767): left half is a sticky intro (pill eyebrow, 1.75rem heading, grey line of copy); right half lists upcoming webinars as bordered rows (date pill + semibold title). With no webinars it renders the CMS empty state, a grey #ddd box reading "No items found.", which is what the only real page shows.
index.webinars-upcoming.scope: Listed on 1 route: Events & webinars index.

product.anchor-intro.description: A single centred 2rem/1.4 H2 (1.5rem at <=767), no paragraph or media. `variant` changes only placement: 'solutions' (/lms/solutions) renders a bare full-width H2 with 1rem top margin; 'features' (/lms/features) wraps it in padding-global > container-medium with 4rem top margin. Always rendered immediately before the sticky-tabs block.
product.anchor-intro.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Features index (sticky anchor tabs).

product.assistant-feature-tabs.description: Header (H2 + grey intro) stacked above a vertical list of 3 items, each with an 8px left track that lights white when active; only the active item shows its body. Beside it a 40% visual column cross-fades between one 30rem-tall video per item. `reversed: true` mirrors the row (visual left, gap 5rem, list column 55%). Used twice in a row on /nova (default, then reversed). <=479 stacks: the visual column hides and the active item shows its own video under the body.
product.assistant-feature-tabs.scope: Listed on 1 route: AI agent product page.

product.assistant-tabs.description: AI-assistant intro header followed by five persona tab buttons driving a looping, draggable slide track (800ms ease); each slide pairs title + copy with a square animation slot. Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (image-slides, video-slides).
product.assistant-tabs.scope: Listed on 20 routes: Marketing homepage; Feature detail; Platform overview; Segment landing: small business.

product.autotabs-group.description: One component with a `variant` prop: 'platform' (/lms and /nova), 'enterprise' (/lms/enterprise), 'mentoring' (/lms/mentoring-software). Centred H2 + grey paragraph, then a row of equal tab buttons ABOVE a full-width loop slider whose slides hold a lead-in title + continuation copy and a 16:9 product screenshot; a centred customer quote closes the block (platform/enterprise reuse TestimonialQuote 'autotabs'/'autotabs-enterprise'; mentoring renders its own 24px quote with a small avatar row). 'platform' renders the slide title inline in white with grey copy run-on; 'enterprise' puts the title on its own line; 'mentoring' nests the slider in an extra padding wrapper and uses cover screenshots. <=767 the tab row wraps (200px tabs, 3.5rem tall); <=479 two tabs per row.
product.autotabs-group.scope: Listed on 4 routes: Platform overview; Segment landing: enterprise; AI agent product page; Mentoring software product page.

product.capability-slider.description: Three-up looping slider of six enterprise capability cards (image + highlighted lead phrase + grey body); autoplays every 3s once 40% visible, with widening progress bullets and a play/pause button. Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (case).
product.capability-slider.scope: Listed on 6 routes: Marketing homepage; Case study detail (platform).

product.card-slider-legacy.description: Legacy hairline-framed header + Webflow-style paged slider of cards with square prev/next arrows bottom-right and round page dots bottom-left; the visible mask is 25% wide (50% <=991, 80% <=767, 95% <=479) with overflow visible, so ~4 cards show at desktop. `variant` gives three shapes: 'journey' (/lms/impact, theme pink): centred H2, 3.42:5 cards with a serif title and 1-2 eyebrow tags; 'library' (/content/service, theme yellow): 2-col header (H2 | grey para), square cards with title + grey text; 'process' (/content/custom-content, theme green): 2-col header, 3.42:5 cards with an auto-numbered 01/02 chip, brand-colour serif title and small text.
product.card-slider-legacy.scope: Listed on 3 routes: Impact (legacy layout, pink theme); Content service (legacy layout); Custom content.

product.comparison-table.description: Raw-HTML-style table embed with its own px-based CSS (re-scoped nct-* classes) and a centred serif H2 (with an italic phrase) plus grey intro above it. One component with a `variant` prop: platform (/lms) is a 2-column capability / 'what you can do' table of 11 rows, nudged 40px right on desktop; enterprise (/lms/enterprise) is a 2-column requirement / provision table of 7 rows whose right cells are green-edged chat-bubble evidence cards; vendor (/nova, directly after the split-tabs block) is a 4-column evaluation checklist (area, what to ask, what good looks like, Nimbus evidence bubble) of 7 rows. Column headers and the visually hidden caption are fixed per variant. At <=767 every variant collapses to stacked rows (vendor cells gain uppercase data-labels).
product.comparison-table.scope: Listed on 3 routes: Platform overview; Segment landing: enterprise; AI agent product page.

product.explore-empty.description: Page-local CMS empty state of the feature-page autotabs block (data-section 'kiki', data-variant 'empty'), padding 5rem top (3rem mob) / 2rem bottom. Top: the shared ExploreHeader in container-medium (28rem column: 1.5rem H2 and a primary 'see every feature' button, then a 2rem spacer). Below, inside the doubled gutter, two stacked full-width #dddddd bars each reading 'No items found.' (0.5rem gap). No tabs, slides or images.

product.feature-bento.description: Split header (H2 left, grey paragraph with one inline link right, bottom-aligned), then a 3-column bento of 4 cards ordered large (spans 2), small, small, large. Each card is a dark rounded panel with an image layer under a 50% wash and bottom fade, copy pinned to the bottom: a white lead phrase run into grey body text (the services card lists inline links), then an arrow text-link. <=991 2 columns (large spans 2); <=767 1 column with 1.5rem gaps. Only on /lms.

product.feature-rows-legacy.description: A bordered stack of 2-column rows (`.section_feature_2-col`): text cell + 3:2 image cell alternating sides, hairline between rows; <=767 rows stack with the text cell first. One component with `variant`: 'impact' (/lms/impact; centred legacy H2 header, rows on a 16px gap, text = H3 28px + paragraph vertically centred), 'service' (/content/service; no header, no top hairline, gapless stretched cells with long paragraphs) and 'services' (/lms/professional-services; no header, 16px gap, text = H4-size 32px title + paragraph + legacy CTA).
product.feature-rows-legacy.scope: Listed on 3 routes: Professional services (legacy grid system); Impact (legacy layout, pink theme); Content service (legacy layout).

product.feature-tabs.description: Section H2 plus four click-driven accordion-style tab rows on the left; matching 670:600 product screenshot fades (.3s) in a pane that bleeds off the right edge. No autoplay. Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (subpage).
product.feature-tabs.scope: Listed on 19 routes: Marketing homepage; Feature detail; Platform overview.

product.features-intro.description: Left-aligned header only: H2 (max 42rem), a 1rem spacer and a grey paragraph (max 36rem) inside container-large > container-medium. No media, no CTA. Only on /lms/features, directly above the anchor intro + sticky tabs.
product.features-intro.scope: Listed on 1 route: Features index (sticky anchor tabs).

product.grid-cards-legacy.description: A legacy-theme section: a header block (split H2 | para, centred H2, left H2, or centred eyebrow + H2 + para + legacy CTA) over one or more rows of hairline `.grid_card` cells (border top/bottom/left, 2/3/4 cols; every row collapses to 1 col <=767, stat row becomes a 2x2 grid <=479). One component with `variant` presets whose card kind differs: 'services-extra' (/lms/professional-services; split header + 3 + 2 text cards), 'people' (/lms/impact; centred H2 + 3 + 2 text cards), 'stats' (/lms/impact; left H2 + 4 stat cards: label, serif brand-colour figure, caption), 'awards' (/lms/impact; centred eyebrow + H2 + a row of 4 award-badge cells) and 'content' (/content; centred eyebrow + H2 + para + CTA, then 2 + 3 image cards: title, 3:2 image, copy).
product.grid-cards-legacy.scope: Listed on 3 routes: Professional services (legacy grid system); Impact (legacy layout, pink theme); Content overview.

product.included-tabs.description: Page-local block for /whats-included. Split header: H2 + grey lead on the left, an italic quote card (avatar, name, role) on the right (stacks <=767). Then a loop slider of full-width slides, each a large rounded panel with an offset 1440:873 product image, a bottom gradient and the module name (H3) + paragraph pinned bottom-left; the tab row sits BELOW the slider (4.75rem; <=767 two per row, 3.5rem). A centred primary CTA follows.

product.integrations-visual.description: Centred H2 + grey paragraph above a wide 1440:410 integrations strip image (padded 1.5rem), optionally followed by a centred primary button. `variant` changes layout only: 'mid-market' (/lms/corporate-lms; 45.25rem container, button below the container), 'enterprise' (/lms/enterprise; same, no button), 'features' (/lms/features; 60rem container, 6rem spacer, larger 24px paragraph in 42rem, button row under the image).
product.integrations-visual.scope: Listed on 3 routes: Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise; Features index (sticky anchor tabs).

product.layout03-tabs.description: Centred H2 + grey paragraph + primary button, then a two-column grid: a vertical list of tab cards (inactive 72px tall showing only the label; the current one expands to show its paragraph) and a pane on the right. `variant` (same content shape): 'image' (/lms/small-business, /lms/corporate-lms; container-large, .3fr/1fr, screenshot anchored bottom-right), 'video' (/lms/enterprise; container-medium, .5fr/1fr, centred 30rem 1:1.1 video), 'video-compact' (/whats-included; like video without section padding, 2.5rem header gap). <=767 two equal columns with 48px tabs; <=479 single column, the pane hides and each tab shows its own screenshot under its text.
product.layout03-tabs.scope: Listed on 4 routes: Segment landing: small business; Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise; What's included.

product.learn-grid.description: A legacy green hairline component (`.section_learn`, no right border) on a 0.75fr / 1fr grid: left = serif 4rem/1.1 H2 + 16px paragraph; right = 2-column list of items, each a green-outlined icon box (plus glyph) + 20px/500 white label, hairline left/bottom rules (last row unruled). Stacks to one column <=767 (list keeps 2 columns). No variants; theme is fixed green.

product.platform-intro.description: Centred, shrink-to-fit header with no section padding: an H2 split into two lines by a forced break, then a grey paragraph also split into two lines by a forced break. No media or CTA. Only on /lms, between the platform hero and the first tabbed slider.

product.release-block.description: Repeated release-note block on /lms/spring-release (6 instances, alternating light #fafefe and page-black themes): a centred header (optional green 'New' pill, H2 with one italic word, body copy, optional button), an optional visual (a 150px looping-video strip under the header, or a product screenshot placed above or below the grid), a 4-column grid of feature items (bold title + text, optionally a customer credit with a 44px avatar; 2 cols <=991, stacked <=479 or <=767 for the wide grid), and an optional big 32px customer quote with a 3rem avatar. Spacers are 4rem / 3rem <=991 / 2rem <=767.
product.release-block.scope: Listed on 1 route: Release notes landing.

product.sector-tabs.description: Legacy-theme block with a `variant` prop producing two different shapes. 'industries' (/lms/solutions, theme green, rendered with id="industries" as the sticky-tabs 5th anchor target): centred serif H2 + grey paragraph, a wrapping row of pill tabs, then one full-width image pane with a bottom gradient, the selected tab name as a large serif label and a theme button. 'topics' (/content, theme yellow): side-hairline frame, eyebrow + H2, a row of 8px/0-radius tag tabs, then a row of 5 topic cards (portrait image + serif title; hover shows a frame and pattern) and an 'All Topics' button. <=767 cards wrap to 3-up, <=479 2-up and tab pills grow to fill rows.
product.sector-tabs.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Content overview.

product.solution-tabs.description: Legacy content (yellow, hairline-framed) block used on /content. Header row: eyebrow chip, large serif H2 and a yellow pill button on the left, grey multi-paragraph copy bottom-aligned on the right. Below, a 5-column frame: a 2/5 vertical tab list (rows share the height; the active row shows its summary on a dotted texture) and a 3/5 image pane with a dark bottom fade and an outlined 'Learn more' button. <=767 the header stacks; <=479 the tabs become an accordion of serif heading rows each opening to its text and image.

product.split-autotabs.description: Page-local block (/lms/corporate-lms once, /lms/enterprise twice). A header slot (H2 alone; H2 | grey intro with an inline link; or eyebrow + H2 | italic quote card with avatar) sits above a loop slider whose slides are split 47%/47%: a 20px title, grey paragraph and optional arrow text-link on the left, a square/1440:1289 product image on the right (stacked <=767). The tab row sits BELOW the slider (equal 4.75rem tabs; <=767 two per row, 3.5rem). An optional closing node follows the slider: on the enterprise services instance a big centred 32px quote with stacked avatar and a centred primary button.
product.split-autotabs.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise.

product.split-tabs.description: Centred header (H2 + grey intro), then a 37rem-tall split: a 40% column of large text tabs (inactive dimmed, current white with the green tab-chip and 2rem indent, hairline rule under each) above a per-tab paragraph + button, and a 55% media pane on the opposite side that cross-fades per tab. `variant` (same content shape): 'base' (/nova; tabs left, 16:9 video pane right, 1-line H2 with italic phrase, 16px intro) and 'reversed' (/lms/mentoring-software; pane left, tabs right, image pane, 2-line H2, 18px intro, blue 'brand' buttons). <=767 stacks: tabs become a horizontally scrolling row, pane 60dvh, copy below.
product.split-tabs.scope: Listed on 2 routes: AI agent product page; Mentoring software product page.

product.sticky-tabs.description: One component with a `variant` prop: 'solutions' (/lms/solutions) and 'features' (/lms/features). A sticky (top 0, z 999) bar of equal anchor pills (green when its panel is in view, scroll-spy) sits over a stack of panels; each panel is a header plus a tab row ABOVE a loop slider whose slides hold one paragraph, a fixed primary button ('Learn more' on solutions, 'Explore' on features) and a clipped product shot. 'solutions' headers are eyebrow + H4-style heading + paragraph beside a bordered stat card (40%); its bar sits in a 45.25rem container and its 5th anchor targets the sector-tabs block further down. 'features' headers are eyebrow / title / paragraph, bar in container-medium. <=767 the anchor bar and tab rows scroll horizontally (200px pills, 150px at <=479) and the stat card stacks under the copy.
product.sticky-tabs.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Features index (sticky anchor tabs).

product.tabs-horizontal-legacy.description: Legacy hairline-framed block (/lms/professional-services, green colours hard-coded). A row of 5 equal tab links (24px labels); the current tab gets a green bottom border and a soft radial glow. Below, one pane split 50/50: 32px H3 + grey paragraph with one bold phrase | a photo (6.835:5.23). No section header. <=767 tabs wrap 2-up with 16px labels and the pane stacks with a 3:2 image.
product.tabs-horizontal-legacy.scope: Listed on 1 route: Professional services (legacy grid system).

product.two-col-features.description: Two alternating rows inside container-medium/large: row 1 text left + square image right, row 2 image left + text right (stacking below 991, image first on row 2). Each text column holds a serif H3-size heading (56/48/40/32px), an 18px grey paragraph (can contain inline links and paragraph breaks) and a translucent quote card (italic quote, 2.5rem avatar, bold name, role with optional linked org). `preset` selects default copy and spacing per route: company (/company), corporate (/lms/corporate-lms, row 1 puts the heading after the quote), enterprise (/lms/enterprise, no reveal motion).
product.two-col-features.scope: Listed on 3 routes: Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise; Company.

product.why-assistant-tabs.description: Four stacked blocks in one component (only /company/why-nimbus): (1) left-aligned balanced H2 with an italic phrase, grey intro and primary button; (2) a tab row above a loop slider of 5 slides (white lead-in + grey run-on copy, a 1:1 video placeholder bleeding right); (3) a split header (H2 | italic quote card with avatar) over split-layout tabs (large text tabs with green chip on the left, a fading screenshot pane bleeding right, per-tab paragraph + dark button); (4) centred results header with an italic word, a 4-up grid of stat cards (logo, big stat, sentence with the customer name as link), a big centred quote with stacked avatar and a primary CTA. <=991 results go 2-up and the split header stacks; <=767 the split tabs become a scrolling row over a 60dvh pane; <=479 cards are 1-up.

product.wow-bento.description: One component with a `variant` prop whose variants have genuinely different shapes. cards (/lms/small-business, 1st): split header (H2 left, small italic side quote right), a 1.5fr/1fr row (rect + square media) then three squares, each with a caption whose lead-in is white, and a centred demo button. cards-cta (/lms/small-business, 2nd): serif H3 + paragraph beside a side quote, then two rect 'Team photo' cards with a serif H4, text and a small dark button each. release (/lms/spring-release): H2 | paragraph + green pill button, then three rows of two feature cards (one per row is 150% wide). included (/mentoring): centred H2 and three feature cards with a 20px title and text. why (/company/why-nimbus): H2 + paragraph + dark button beside a quote card, two square photos (event, team) with a caption, an awards line with four award shields, and a closing large quote. All stack at <=991/767.
product.wow-bento.scope: Listed on 4 routes: Segment landing: small business; Release notes landing; Mentoring programmes; Why us.

proof.case-results.description: Page-local function on /case-studies/lms: a centred H2 and grey paragraph in a 50rem column, then a single 6-track grid `repeat(5, min-content) 1fr` of five dark cards, each as wide as its stat (clipped by the page section on mobile rather than wrapping). Each card shows a brand-green challenge label, the customer logo, a 64px stat (48/40px on smaller breakpoints) and a grey result sentence ending in the linked customer name. A centred primary button follows. Differs from the shared Results block in grid behaviour, labels and the trailing customer link.
proof.case-results.scope: Listed on 1 route: Case study index (platform, filterable).

proof.case-study-carousel.description: Header (H2 + button left, paragraph right) over a centred, looping carousel of five case-study cards (photo with brand logo, title, two stats); centre card scaled 1.1, neighbours at 20% opacity; 4s autoplay paused on hover. Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (subpage).
proof.case-study-carousel.scope: Listed on 6 routes: Marketing homepage; Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Features index (sticky anchor tabs); Company; Why us; Contact.

proof.case-study-video.description: A dark rounded video card (min 60vh inner, 50vh tab, 40vh <=479) with the customer logo top-left, a large spacer, the H2 story headline bottom-left and a 4rem round play button bottom-right, over a background video still faded out by a radial mask. Below it two stat/quote cards sit side by side (one column <=479), each with a 24px heading (48px <=991, 40px <=767) and a grey paragraph. Used once, on /lms/mentoring-software.
proof.case-study-video.scope: Listed on 1 route: Mentoring software product page.

proof.centred-quote.description: Page-local block placed directly after the Results card grid inside the same container-medium wrapper: a 32px (28 tab / 24 mob) medium-weight quote in a 60rem column (centred, or left-aligned on /lms/small-business), a stacked avatar (5rem, 3rem on small-business) with the site's 6px tag corners below 1440 and round at >=1440, the name and a grey role with an optional linked org; the page then renders a centred primary button row. On /lms the same markup is the inline FinalQuote function (quote + author + button in one component). /lms/enterprise uses CentredQuote twice: after Results, and as the `after` slot of the service SplitAutotabs.
proof.centred-quote.scope: Listed on 3 routes: Platform overview; Segment landing: small business; Segment landing: enterprise.

proof.cs-content-stats.description: Three hairline-bordered cards in a row (one column at 991 and below) on the content ("yellow") legacy theme: a dotted-texture card with a large yellow Source Serif stat and its label, a "Solutions" card with bordered chips, and a "Topics used" card with chips that optionally carry a check-circle icon. The stat number and solutions list rise in on scroll.
proof.cs-content-stats.scope: Listed on 5 routes: Case study detail (content).

proof.flip-logos.description: Four logo cells in a row (2x2 at <=767) between side hairlines, each with legacy-theme borders. Every cell masks a 3rem-high window onto a vertical track of four logos, so 16 logos are shown four at a time. Once the section scrolls into view each track steps upward through its logos on a staggered, looping GSAP timeline. Geometry is identical on every route; only the legacy colour theme changes (yellow on /content/topics, /content/sector-suites and /content/service, pink on /lms/impact, green on /content/custom-content).
proof.flip-logos.scope: Listed on 5 routes: Content catalogue (topics / sector suites); Impact (legacy layout, pink theme); Content service (legacy layout); Custom content.

proof.logo-row.description: Static (non-scrolling) row of six customer logos under a one-line caption; wraps to a grid on mobile. Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (subpage).
proof.logo-row.scope: Listed on 29 routes: Marketing homepage; Feature detail; Segment landing: small business; Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Release notes landing; Book a demo; Features index (sticky anchor tabs); AI agent product page; Mentoring programmes; Company; Why us; What's included; Contact.

proof.results-proof.description: Page-local block: centred serif H2 with one italic word and a grey lead, then a 4-column grid (2 cols <=991, 1 col <=479) of three dark stat cards (customer logo, big stat, grey outcome line with an italic phrase) plus a translucent quote card (logo, 6rem-padded quote, small round avatar with name/role). It ends either with a green CTA card (text + dark button, /company) or a centred primary button row (/whats-included). Unlike the homepage Results block it carries the quote card and the CTA.
proof.results-proof.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Company; What's included.

proof.results-stats.description: Centred H2 over a 4-column grid of dark stat cards (customer logo, large stat, grey sentence with inline brand link); 2 columns at <=991px, 1 at <=479px. Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (subpage).
proof.results-stats.scope: Listed on 7 routes: Marketing homepage; Platform overview; Segment landing: small business; Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise; Professional services (legacy grid system); Book a demo.

proof.reviews-grid.description: Serif H3-size centred heading, then a row (stacks <=767) of a 2-column customer-logo grid card (10 logos, 3rem gaps) beside a max-56rem testimonial card holding a one-slide reviews carousel: each slide has a customer logo, a 24px quote, a 3rem avatar with name/role, and a faded brand image top-right; prev/next outline arrows sit bottom-right. On /pricing a centred video block (H2 with an italic word + 4:3 video placeholder with play button, the VideoSection component) is nested inside the same <section> after the row, passed as children.

proof.reviews-slider.description: Centred H2 above a 60rem one-slide-at-a-time carousel. Each slide is a tall dark panel (min 32.5rem, 35rem <=479) with a customer logo top-left, a customer image pinned top-right, and at the bottom a 28px quote plus a 3rem-avatar author row; `order` puts the author first (content, corporate, integrations, professional services, whats-included) or the quote first (/lms/features/*). Inactive slides sit at scale .65 / opacity .5. Prev/next round arrows overlap the slider's bottom-right corner, and a centred primary button follows. With `slides=[]` (the CMS empty state on /lms/features/employee-experience and /lms/features/communication) the slider is replaced by a single 'No items found.' bar while the heading, arrows and button stay.
proof.reviews-slider.scope: Listed on 24 routes: Feature detail; Content catalogue (topics / sector suites); Segment landing: mid-market; Professional services (legacy grid system); Integrations directory; Content overview; What's included.

proof.stats-countup.description: Page-local block on /company: a small (24px, 20px mob) Inter H2 with one italic phrase and a grey lead, centred, then three square dark stat cards in a row, each with a label + short line at the top and a big number with suffix at the bottom. At <=767 the three 18.75rem squares stay in one row and scroll sideways (hidden scrollbar), as on the original.

proof.testimonial.description: Single large pull quote with 80px avatar, name and role/company line, centred under the stats grid.

proof.testimonial-card-legacy.description: A hairline-bordered card (legacy theme border colour) over a decorative full-bleed background image at 85% opacity, holding a 2-column grid: customer logo on the left, and on the right a body-size quote with a client row below (3.5rem round photo, semibold name, grey role). Padding 3.5rem/2.5rem, tightening per breakpoint; at <=767 it becomes one column and the client photo stacks above the name. Theme switches the legacy colour set (yellow on /content/service, green on /content/custom-content); the logo box is tall (5rem, 3rem at >=1440) or wide (2.5rem).
proof.testimonial-card-legacy.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Content service (legacy layout); Custom content.

proof.testimonial-quote.description: One component with a `variant` prop: a 32px (28 tab / 24 mob) medium-weight quote in a 60rem column, above a stacked author block (avatar, name, grey role + linked or bold org). Variants only change spacing, alignment and avatar size: platform (/lms 1st, /lms/features, /lms/solutions with a centred button row below), platform-lg (/lms 2nd, 5rem top + 4rem bottom margin), section (/lms 3rd, 5rem/3rem section padding, button rendered inside the author block), mid-market (/lms/corporate-lms, bare left-aligned quote, 2rem top margin), enterprise (/lms/enterprise, centred quote with 2rem left pad, 1rem top margin), kiki (/nova, 6rem/5rem/3.5rem top pad, 3rem avatar). Avatar is a 5rem (3rem kiki) square with the site's 6px TL/BR tag corners below 1440 and fully round at >=1440.
proof.testimonial-quote.scope: Listed on 6 routes: Platform overview; Segment landing: mid-market; Segment landing: enterprise; Solutions index (sticky anchor tabs); Features index (sticky anchor tabs); AI agent product page.

shell.footer.description: Dark rounded footer card: 'ask an AI' icon row, wordmark + socials, four link columns, rating and award badges, compliance line and legal drop-up menus.

shell.nav.description: Fixed, transparent top bar: wordmark, centred pill of hover-open dropdown menus (300ms close delay), AI 'Ask' link, primary 'Book a demo' button; collapses to a full-screen menu at <=991px.

story.brand-video.description: H2 and intro paragraph above a 16:9 video slot with play button (static placeholder; the original embeds YouTube), with a closing paragraph below. Same component reused on subpages with a variant prop (subpage).
story.brand-video.scope: Listed on 20 routes: Marketing homepage; Feature detail; AI agent product page; Mentoring software product page.

story.company-news.description: Left-aligned header (green-chip eyebrow, H2, one-line lead), then a 0.6fr / 1fr grid (one column <=767): a featured news card (3:2 image, serif title, grey summary, faded date + read-time meta) beside a rounded list of four headline rows separated by hairlines. Card and rows are links whose background lightens on hover. Used once, on /company.

story.custom-video.description: Legacy green-theme hairline block (left and bottom borders only) in container-large: a header with a 64px serif H2 (max 42rem) and a green pill button, then a bordered 2-column grid of a 16:9 video lightbox thumbnail (right hairline) and a 20px paragraph. One column at <=767, with the paragraph moved above the thumbnail at <=479. Used once, on /content/custom-content.

story.grid-split-legacy.description: One hairline-framed `.grid_section` row split into a header cell (left, padding 2.5rem / 1.5 <=991 / 1.25 <=767) and a companion cell (right); stacks to one column <=767. One component with `variant`: 'testimonial' (/lms/professional-services; cols 1fr .6fr, H2 + grey para | bottom-aligned quote card with italic quote, 40px avatar, name, role + linked org), 'text' (/lms/professional-services; 1:1, H2 | grey 16px paragraph), 'image' (/lms/impact; no top hairline, 16px gap, H3 28px + para + legacy CTA vertically centred | 3:2 story image) and 'suites' (/content/sector-suites; no top hairline, spacer + H2 + para | CTA bottom-right, followed by a 3-col (1 col <=767) list of hairline link cards: H3 + grey text + 3:2 image).
story.grid-split-legacy.scope: Listed on 4 routes: Content catalogue (topics / sector suites); Professional services (legacy grid system); Impact (legacy layout, pink theme).

story.header-image-legacy.description: A hairline (#00251e, no top line) 2-column card with no gap: left cell holds a serif H2 (4rem/1.1 at every width), a 16px ink paragraph and a row of 4 review badges (h 4rem, 3rem <=479); right cell is a square team photo. Padding 5rem 2.5rem (3rem 1.5rem <=991, 1.5rem <=767); stacks to one column <=767. Not the page H1 (it follows the centred legacy hero on /lms/professional-services). No variants, no theme prop.
story.header-image-legacy.scope: Listed on 1 route: Professional services (legacy grid system).

story.marquee.description: One component with a `variant` prop. header (/lms/small-business): centred serif H2 and a grey paragraph with one inline link, three full-width rows of white-text pills, then a primary + dark button pair. plain (/mentoring, four instances, `set` 1-4): just two rows of grey-text pills inside padding-global, each placed straight after a wow2col block. Each row is an edge-faded (0 -> 15% / 85% -> 0 mask) overflow-hidden strip whose track holds the pill list twice and scrolls with a CSS keyframe loop; rows alternate direction.
story.marquee.scope: Listed on 2 routes: Segment landing: small business; Mentoring programmes.

story.scroll-quote.description: Short analyst-style quote whose letters scroll-scrub from near-black to white one by one; the page's only ScrollTrigger-driven text effect.

story.wow-2col.description: A 2-column row in container-medium: the text column has the H2 pinned to the top and, pinned to the bottom (4rem minimum gap), a large 24px lead (optionally held to 28rem) and an 18px grey paragraph; the right column is a 1:1 dark rounded image card. Stacks at <=991 on /mentoring (stackTab) or <=767 by default, with a 20rem minimum image height. Used four times on /mentoring, each followed by a plain marquee.

story.zoom-statement.description: Full-bleed 1440:598 image that scroll-scrubs from 2.5x/transparent to 1x/opaque, followed by a centred serif H2 and multi-line grey statement paragraph.
